details.name: MOB.722_AssetLookup_Reading_Capture
details.message:
`MOB.722` **Capture a reading from Asset Lookup's Readings tab** — proved over `/graphql`.
- On the first `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE` row (a critical guard requires its `Name` to be `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE <8 digits>`
  before anything is written) — not a fixture, and not an asset whose readings another test counts.
- Reading type `Test 1`: added through `Add reading types` only when the asset lacks it (the picker
  hides types already shown), so every run ends at the same field.
- Types `722<5 random digits>`, tabs out to arm Submit (`filledInputs` counts on blur), submits.
- ⭐ **Server proof**: the asset's `latestReadings` for that type is exactly the typed value — the
  toast is transient and the rendered previous entry is the app's own cache write (trap 6).
- ⚠️ **LEAVES RESIDUE**: one Event per run (`Test 1`, `722xxxxx`) on that throwaway asset.

steps.name: Navigate to asset lookup
Wait for the page to mount
Test the "Asset Lookup" page rendered
Focus the search input
Select any persisted query first (typeText APPENDS — trap 17)
Search for "DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE"
Submit the search (Enter — there is no search button)
RESULT GUARD: a "DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE" row rendered (MOB.600 residue)

steps.name: ENSURE 1/3: the `Test 1` field is already on the form — or open `Add reading types` (once, when it is not loading)
ENSURE 2/3: the field exists — or `Test 1` is picked in the MultiSelect (a pill)
ENSURE 3/3: confirm with `Add` if the picker is open — the `Test 1` field is on the form; tag its input
Focus the `Test 1` reading input
Enter the reading `722<RUNID>`
The input holds `722` + 5 digits; record it (the JS never reads RUNID)
Tab out — the form's onBlur recounts `filledInputs` (arms Submit)
Submit is ARMED — this row's `button[form="asset-lookup-readings-…"]` is `type="submit"` (trap 8)
Submit the reading (CREATE_EVENT)

Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
